# Paired circular outlines

Original controls generated by `tools/picture_3d_circle_outline_fixture.py` from
our independently authored dense-texture OPC. No corpus document or artwork is
copied. Five 178-point circles share a neutral gray PNG, perspectiveRight camera,
20-point extrusion, 4.5-point navy contour and top three-point lighting. Only the
navy outline varies: absent, omitted width, explicit 0.75, 3 and 8 points.

`native.pdf` was exported by the reference application. All five native picture
images use lossless Flate encoding. `tools/record_picture_3d_markers.py` binds the
PDF and DOCX hashes and records boundaries at four pixels per point. The browser
comparison uses matching resolution and the existing 1.25-point bidirectional
boundary-distance acceptance bound. Initial maximum measured distance is
0.559017 point. Omitted and explicit 0.75-point outlines produce the same native
measurements. This evidence does not establish a new reference/spec divergence.

These measurements reject the suspected circle-outline placement error in corpus
card #10. They do not prove the photographic card perfect or clear its partial
status. High-resolution antialiasing and photo resampling remain separate issues.
